laws.rule: Walking in swimwear or partly undressed in the Old Town zone and on city streets is banned outside bathing zones. Natural persons are fined €200 (about A$318 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026) to €1000 (about A$1,589 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026). Communal police told RTV Budva the fine issued is €200 and more than 30 had been issued.
